dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, distinct white band across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against darker wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible thin, pale margins along the edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers providing moderate boundary sharpness.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A yellowish-white oval or irregular patch visible on the posterior neck between the crown and mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp and distinct linear boundary between the black crown and the olive-green mantle/yellowish nape.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white auricular (cheek) patch completely enclosed by a black border.
